The '''Drogheda Citadel''' was a near impenetrable [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]]. It was the headquarters of the ruling family of the planet, and as it was located on the edge of a soaring peak, it was only reachable by [[sky-sled]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the citadel was attacked by the a [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|popular revolutionary movement]], with aid from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Danu]], sister of the reigning [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]]. Sarna was ultimately captured and deposed, and the revolutionaries took control of the palace with the intention of setting up a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government.<ref name="marvel83" />
